checks.name: whitespace
checks.command:
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import subprocess,json
from pathlib import Path
r=Path.cwd();o=Path('~/Workspace/alien_planet_chronicles');before=json.loads(Path('../r002-before.json').read_text());errors=[];checked=0
for b in sorted(r.rglob('*')):
 if not b.is_file() or b.suffix not in ('.md','.json','.py','.yaml'):continue
 n=b.relative_to(r).as_posix();a=o/n
 if n in before and a.read_bytes()==b.read_bytes():continue
 checked+=1;p=subprocess.run(['git','diff','--no-index','--check','--',str(a) if a.exists() else '/dev/null',str(b)],capture_output=True,text=True)
 if p.returncode not in (0,1) or p.stdout or p.stderr:errors.append({'file':n,'detail':p.stdout+p.stderr})
print({'checked':checked,'errors':errors});raise SystemExit(bool(errors))
PY
